source.title: 2027 Holiday Schedule (NC Office of State Human Resources); also https://oshr.nc.gov/state-employee-resources/benefits/leave/holidays

weekendRule: Sat->Fri, Sun->Mon for single-day holidays (Jul 4, 2026 observed Fri Jul 3; Jul 4, 2027 observed Mon Jul 5); Christmas days are set annually as a three-weekday block.

stateHolidays.name: Day after Thanksgiving
stateHolidays.note: Thanksgiving holiday is two days (Thu Nov 25 and Fri Nov 26, 2027).

stateHolidays.name: Christmas holiday, additional day 1
stateHolidays.rule: other:one of three weekdays around Christmas, set annually by the State Human Resources Commission (2027: Thu Dec 23)
stateHolidays.note: Christmas is a three-day holiday every year; 2026: Dec 24, 25, 28; 2027: Dec 23, 24, 27 (Dec 25 is a Saturday); 2028: Dec 22, 25, 26.

stateHolidays.name: Christmas holiday, additional day 2
stateHolidays.rule: other:one of three weekdays around Christmas, set annually by the State Human Resources Commission (2027: Fri Dec 24)
stateHolidays.note: See additional day 1. Christmas Day itself is counted among the federal holidays; the three days total 3 paid days.

partialOrLocal.name: Personal Observance Leave
partialOrLocal.note: Entitlement of 8 hours/year for a day of cultural, religious or personal significance (OSHR Holidays Policy page). Personal leave, not a scheduled holiday; can be used on Juneteenth or Columbus Day.
